libs.note: BH-9912. The knob-gated deny layer for the iron guardrails. When on, bin/agent-call.sh gives the guarded lanes (IRON_LAW_LANES) the permissions.deny list in bin/deny-guardrails-settings.json, as a --settings file and as --disallowedTools, and bin/iron-law-guard.sh judges family 8 (gh api merge calls, wrangler d1 --remote writes, pnpm/yarn/bun <bin> runner forms). Applied by agent-call.sh with lib_env_apply deny-guardrails "$PROJECT", so a per-project row turns it on for one project first.

knobs.note: 1 = the deny layer and guard family 8 are on; anything else = off. Read as ${DENY_GUARDRAILS:-0} in bin/agent-call.sh and bin/iron-law-guard.sh; rows lib.deny-guardrails.deny_guardrails (fleet) and lib.deny-guardrails.<project>.deny_guardrails (one project). Default 0 (ticket BH-9912: on for cromford lanes first).
